summary_md: **Obie Fernandez ([@obie](https://x.com/obie/status/2115392751374348413))** updated **slopcore**, his open-source Claude Code plugin and skill for making AI music videos from your own songs. The self-reply lists v0.3.0 changes: characters and sets designed before stills, GPT Image stills checked by two reviewer agents, 480p Seedance drafts with only approved shots rendered at 1080p, and mandatory lip-sync for singing shots.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - obie/slopcore: A Claude Code skill and toolkit for making AI music videos from a finished song: Midjourney stills, Seedance clips, and every lyric drawn in code on the beat.

relevance: A real agentic media pipeline, with reviewer agents and draft-then-render gating, packaged as a harness plugin.
